title: KTR PBMC KO_10X_220524_1 GEX
characteristics_ch1: treatment: mRNA vaccination study; Moderna; ID1; response group(s): R
treatment_protocol_ch1: Kidney transplant recipients were sampled longitudinally during mRNA vaccination. Samples include pre-vaccination, post-vaccination, and later booster-associated time points from mRNA-1273 and BNT162b2 vaccine cohorts. Participants were classified as responders or non-responders using the study antibody-response criteria.
growth_protocol_ch1: Not applicable; primary human peripheral blood mononuclear cells were analyzed.
extract_protocol_ch1: Peripheral blood mononuclear cells were isolated within 2 hours of blood collection using Ficoll-Paque PLUS and cryopreserved for batched single-cell processing.

Single-cell libraries were generated using the 10x Genomics Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 3' v3.1 platform. Oligonucleotide-conjugated antibody-derived tags were used for surface-protein measurements, and TotalSeq-A hashtag oligonucleotides were used for sample multiplexing. GEX, ADT, and HTO libraries are represented separately in the SAMPLES section. Feature definitions are provided in feature_README.txt.
description: 10x Genomics Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 3' v3.1 gene-expression library from an HTO-multiplexed PBMC reaction. Patient/timepoint samples represented after HTO demultiplexing: V20_ID1 (Moderna, Discovery, R); V26_ID1 (Moderna, Discovery, R); V44_ID1 (Moderna, Discovery, R); V53_ID1 (Moderna, Discovery, R); V57_ID1 (Moderna, Discovery, R). The linked patient-specific Seurat RDS files contain cell-level RNA counts and available ADT/HTO assays.
data_processing: Cell Ranger v7.1.0 was used for alignment and feature-barcode processing using the 10x Genomics human gene-expression reference refdata-gex-GRCh38-2020-A.
Hashtag oligonucleotide counts were used for computational sample demultiplexing with HTODemux. Participant-specific Seurat objects were generated from the demultiplexed cells.
Quality control retained cells with 500-50,000 UMIs, 200-6,000 detected genes, and mitochondrial transcript fraction below 5%; doublets were evaluated with Scrublet.

Public RDS files were checked for readability and preservation of cell-level RNA counts. Available ADT and HTO assays were retained. An internal patient-identifier metadata field present in one object was removed from the public copy.

Eleven participant/timepoint samples were re-sequenced. Primary and re-sequencing patient-level RDS objects are provided as separate uniquely named processed files associated with their originating pooled reactions.
Supplementary files format and content: RDS files containing patient-specific Seurat objects with cell-level RNA count matrices and available ADT/HTO assays after HTO-based demultiplexing.

Supplementary files format and content: feature_README.txt provides ADT and HTO feature definitions. For the retained 2021 legacy ADT panel, feature identities were recovered from Cell Ranger features.tsv.gz files; unavailable oligo sequence fields were left blank rather than inferred.
